skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts and principles of business and business management.
Analyze and evaluate internal and external factors affecting business operations and management.
Apply basic management principles to solve business problems and optimize operations.
Develop skills in decision making, teamwork, and effective communication in diverse business environments.
Process, analyze data, and communicate findings to stakeholders.
Prepare and report insights from business data to stakeholders.
Understand social responsibility, business ethics, and human rights issues.
Manage time and adapt to changing work environments, globalization, and Industry 4.0.
Understand the role and historical development of management and leadership.
Manage human resources, including employment processes and employee benefits.
Understand the nature and scope of marketing and develop marketing plans.
Manage business finances, including budgets, financial reports, and capital types.
Understand the importance and forms of international business.
